name: ovl_tank_amber
layer: decoration_fx (draw right after the tile, before y-sorted sprites)

anchor.meaning: top-left of frame = top-left px of the tank's _0_0 tile (map cell of that tile id)

phase_rule: frame = (floor(t_ms / ms) + phase_offsets_frames[(7*x0 + 3*y0) % 6]) % frames; x0,y0 = map cell of the anchor tile
emissive: px in the 8 night-glow colours use the lit LUT, rest the sprite LUT
notes: 1x2 specimen tank (amber). 7 rising bubbles (1-2 art px, 1-2 rises/loop, 1-px sway), 5 drifting specks; masked to the lean glass cylinder.
readability_rule: overlay px with |dLuma|>=28 vs the ToD-graded tank tile under them (tile snapped to palette); pass >= 0.5 per phase
